questions.stemHtml: Q1. A 10-year-old boy requires an amputation due to severe trauma to his ankle. The surgeon discusses two options: Syme’s amputation and Boyd’s amputation. Which statement accurately describes a key feature of each procedure?

options.label: A
options.text: Syme’s allows for full weight-bearing; Children benefit greatly from Boyd’s.

options.label: B
options.text: Syme’s involves talectomy and fusion; Boyd’s preserves the distal physis.

options.label: C
